description: Demolition of an existing masonry outbuilding and construction of a new timber-clad garden studio in the rear garden.
decision_conditions: The proposed demolition of the rear garden folly is considered<span id="docs-internal-guid-1b70d058-7fff-aa97-f724-1ebb907a46b1"><span id="docs-internal-guid-d56dece3-7fff-70ce-23aa-4549511fb5b9"><span id="docs-internal-guid-477bce87-7fff-c35b-d6eb-741354fef1d3"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;"> to be harmful to the significance of the listed building through the loss of a historic garden structure of interest with a large structure </span></span><span style="text-align: justify;">which would fail to preserve the verdant garden setting of the listed building and the character and appearance of the De Beauvoir Conservation Area.&nbsp;</span>As such, the proposal is contrary to policies D3, D4 and HC1 of The London Plan (2021) and policies LP1, LP3&nbsp;and LP17 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), and the guidance contained within Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2009).<span id="docs-internal-guid-767e2df5-7fff-6b8f-7ca2-06dd58ef4697"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;"><br></span></div></span>

The proposed development, by reason of its size, scale, location, and detailed design, would result in an overly-dominant, obtrusive, and incongruous form of development that would fail to be subordinate to and in keeping with the host building, would fail to conserve or enhance and reveal the significance of the locally listed asset and its setting and would fail to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the conservation area. As such, the proposal is contrary to policies D3, D4 and HC1 of The London Plan (2021) and policies LP1, LP3&nbsp;and LP17 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), and the guidance contained within Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2009).<span id="docs-internal-guid-767e2df5-7fff-6b8f-7ca2-06dd58ef4697"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;"> </span></span>
